lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank superior to the pectoral fin, showing an irregular distribution with higher spatial frequency in the anterior portion of the visible frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated remora (Echeneidae) swimming adjacent to the ventral surface, and several smaller yellow-pigmented fish (likely Gnathanodon speciosus) located near the lower margin of the shark's flank.
